configurations._comment: apps/web, run from the workspace root via the root 'dev' script. Every entry here needs apps/server already serving the API at VITE_API_BASE — vite proxies /api and /health there. With nothing listening the app still renders, but every query fails and practice never produces a problem.
configurations.name: web

configurations._comment: Second dev server on its own port, so a second session can run one while 'web' is already up on 5173.
configurations.name: web-alt

configurations._comment: With Supabase auth enabled — fill in VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY for your project. Leave both VITE_SUPABASE_* unset (the 'web' entry) for the single-user build with no sign-in: the web must agree with the backend about whether a session is required.
configurations.name: web-auth
